Our Accommodation.

About
Granite Domes House.
A spacious and relaxing home nestled in the small country town of Minnipa on the upper Eyre Peninsula of South Australia. Explore the Gawler Ranges National Park or Pildappa Rock along with the natural attractions in the district.

About Granite Domes Accommodation
0
About
As your hosts, we farm just north of Minnipa and are willing to assist with your stay in any way possible. We love travelling ourselves and appreciate the value of accommodation options and unique experiences.
Great pride is taken in providing a high standard of cleanliness, communication and comfort at Granite Domes. We take pleasure in sharing it with you.
Fiona & Pete
